simple.meaning: יִפְעָה (yiphʻâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “splendor or (figuratively) beauty.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יִפְעָה (H3314) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 28:7, with occurrences in Ezekiel.

simple.summary: יִפְעָה (yiphʻâh) / H3314 is traced through Ezekiel 28:7, Ezekiel 28:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3314. yiphah [ יִפְעָה ] noun feminine brightness, splendour , יִפְעָתֶ֑ךָ Ezek 28:7 , 17 of prince and king of Tyre.
